mapper.select: SELECT S.SITE_TTL AS SITE_TITLE, S.HMPG_ADDR AS HOMEPAGE_URL, S.MNGR_EML_ADDR AS MANAGER_EMAIL, S.EDNST_NM AS INSTITUTION_NAME, S.EDNST_ADDR AS INSTITUTION_ADDRESS, S.EDNST_TELNO AS INSTITUTION_TEL, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = S.LOGO_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS LOGO_URL, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = S.FAVICON_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS FAVICON_URL, S.FTR_CN AS FOOTER_CONTENT FROM SITE_BASIC_STNG S WHERE S.STNG_ID = 'DEFAULT'
